description:
On the Twin Cast podcast, we sit down with Mia Hibbert, owner of the Atlanta Wild, to talk about consistency, self-discipline, and why success is built one step at a time.

Mia shares the reality that not every day feels productive or motivating. Some days are exciting, while others feel difficult. But progress isn't about being perfect every day—it's about continuing to move forward even when motivation isn't there.

This conversation is a reminder to give yourself grace while staying committed to your goals. The biggest achievements in life rarely happen overnight. They're built through small decisions, repeated consistently over time.

One of the biggest takeaways from this clip is that success isn't one giant leap. It's a million small steps in the right direction.

Keep showing up. One day at a time.

Follow for more Twin Cast conversations, leadership lessons, and real-world discussions.
